notes.title: Summary of major updates
notes.notes:
We have slashed the price from $2.99 to $1.27.
Changed the trailer to long movies showing actual play.
Added Free Soundtrack
Added 2 extra levels
Added weather and day/night cycles to hard mode.
XBOX controller is now supported.
Paradise franchise was abandoned. (Transferred to Easy2Enjoy Franchise)

notes.title: The Brainwasher
notes.notes:
According to global achievement data, 10% of players beat the Brainwasher who only appears in hard mode.
We thought the Brainwasher's attacks were extremely powerful and few players could defeat him, but the results were surprising.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35110241/2a03141aa6cae5f6273f7636f6a14d084c3e1d84.png[/img]

notes.title: Paradise
notes.notes:
Paradise has developed (Paradise OS) a system that lets people experience the ideal world by plugging into the human brain and manipulating brain currents. The first world created by Paradise was a game of simple document collection. Paradise opened up the system to the general public and created many so-called "brain indie" developers.
There was a dramatic increase in the number of people engrossed in paradise, but the DiceCity administration welcomed it to divert people's discontent with the government.
Soon, rumors began to spread that "When you see RISA with red eyes, you lose emotion.". (From PARADISE, the next game)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35110241/11162ce52901721b01f9520dc033d3765edb07ba.png[/img]

notes.title: RISA
notes.notes:
RISA is the friendly AI that was installed in Paradise's first “game”.
There is also male AI called "KEN" for women.

notes.title: Notification
notes.notes:
This game has been price cut.
The Paradise franchise was abandoned and the game moved to the Easy2Enjoy franchise.
The solution to the case where objects are not displayed in the game has been added to the store page.

notes.title: Version 1.07
notes.notes:
Version 1.07
We released free DLC, sound track.
Added a day and night cycle to the hard mode.

notes.title: Soundtrack
notes.notes:
As you all fans know, the soundtrack of the Sonic-Alpha game I composed is free.
This time, I recorded all 5 songs of First Customer and Android Amazones as mp3 files.
Releases to match the release date of Android Amazones.

notes.title: Update
notes.notes:
Update
Added realistic fog to hard mode.

notes.title: Xbox controller
notes.notes:
I set up the Xbox controller and did a test play.

Character movement: Left stick
Camera movement: Right stick
Open the door(Extra) : B
Jump: A
Change weapons: Y
Reload: X
Dash: LS click , B
Squatting on the fly: RS click
Aim target: LT
Shoot Weapons: RT
Secondary grenade: Right bumper

notes.title: Bug fix
notes.notes:
The problems caused by the update. 
We fixed problem that you can not get Steam Achievements.(in normal mode) 
We fixed problem that you can not complete the level.(in normal mode)
Fixed an issue that caused delays when players picked up items. 
We apologize for the inconvenience.

notes.title: Version 1.06
notes.notes: Improved graphics drawing in normal mode.Fixed the behavior when looking through the scope in normal mode. The enemy's detection range in the hospital has been expanded.I removed the sniper rifle from normal mode because it works strangely. Added level descriptions to the lobby. Reduced the attack speed of the assault rifle in normal mode. Fixed the attack speed of enemies in hard mode.

notes.title: Version 1.05
notes.notes:
Version 1.05
Added camera lighting, bloom effect, blur effect, etc. to all levels.

notes.title: Version 1.04
notes.notes:
Version 1.04
Added extra level 2 "HOSPITAL".
You do not have a weapon.
Please collect important documents so that you are not found by the enemy.
The game is now 5GB. I am concerned about the capacity of the player's hard disk, so I might move to the development of my next work, PARADISE.

notes.title: Update schedule for version 1.04
notes.notes:
Update schedule for version 1.04
Extra level 2: "Hospital" will be added
Mouse Inversion: This game uses a total of 50 assets and licenses. If it takes time to incorporate the script, this setting will not be implemented.
The capacity of the game will exceed 4GB.
Thank you for playing!

notes.title: Version 1.03
notes.notes:
Version 1.03 
Added extra level "THE CITY".
This level of focus on gunfights, but the task of collecting important documents is the same as at other levels.
This city is also one of the brain projection systems operated by Paradise.
If the screen display is strange, press the ESC key to set the graphics.
You will find the reason why the player's display is gray at the end of the game.
This game is not Early Access. All updates are made for the benefit of the player.

notes.title: Version 1.02 update
notes.notes:
Version 1.02 update
Reduced the hit rate of the enemy's assault rifle in normal mode.
Reduced the enemy's attack power in hard mode.
The camera drawing distance has been shortened.
The sensing range of BrainWasher [RARE] was changed from 90 degrees to 360 degrees.
Extra level to be added will not affect existing levels. The time to add is undecided.
